preamble.summary: Psalm 143 — preserved in 11QPsᵃ as part of its alternative Pss 91–150 ordering. Tracks MT in content; the difference is positional rather than textual.
preamble.notable_variants: 11QPsᵃ alternative ordering — see /dss-psalms index for the full sequence. No significant content variants. Minor orthographic variation only (the standard Qumran plene-spelling tendency).
preamble.scroll_condition: Fragmentary attestation; no continuous DSS coverage.
